text: The most defined cell-free translation system, reconstituted entirely from individually purified components rather than crude cell lysate, is called the ___ system.
explanation: PURE is fully reconstituted from purified ribosomes, aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases, translation factors, tRNAs, and T7 RNA polymerase, making it completely defined with no unknown components, unlike crude E. coli extract-based systems.
